title: Silybum marianum essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Silybum marianum essential oil is derived from the seeds of the milk thistle plant, known for its hepatoprotective properties. This oil is used in herbalism to support liver function and detoxification processes in the body. It is often applied topically to reduce inflammation and promote skin healing. In traditional medicine, it has been used to treat ailments related to the liver and digestive system. Its active compounds, such as silymarin, are believed to help protect liver cells from damage.
